notes: p5-8: Each printed row runs across a two-page spread (party columns Acción Renovadora..Socialista Popular on the left page 5/7; Laborista..Independientes and the totals on the right page 6/8). Each row is recorded once, on the left page (5 or 7), with all its values; in that page's axis the right-page labels carry x-ranges offset by +1 (x-1 is the fraction of the facing page 6/8, whose own axis is also given). Spans are y on the left page measured near the middle of the table; the scans are skewed (right side up to ~0.015 of page height higher than the left), so spans are approximate.

p5-8: Commune assignment: rows printed in capitals are communes; indented rows beneath (e.g. Huara, Pica, Lagunas, Putre, General Lagos, San Pedro de Atacama) may have been communes in their own right in 1953. 'Ligua' is assigned commune 'La Ligua'. 'Ciudad de Valparaíso' is the printed total of the five Valparaíso civil circumscriptions (level commune).

p5-8: Columns not running in a grouping (all dashes) are omitted: in circ. 1 Acción Renovadora, Conservador, Conservador Tradicionalista, Democrático del Pueblo, Unión Nacional de Independientes, Mov. Nac. de Jubilados, Independientes; in circ. 3 Democrático de Chile, Falange, Laborista, Radical Doctrinario, Unión Nacional de Independientes, Mov. Nac. del Pueblo. Mov. Nac. de Jubilados runs in circ. 3 per the reference (18 votes) but is all dashes on pp. 7-8 (its votes must be in Quillota/Valparaíso province rows on later pages), so it is omitted here.

p5-8: The volume prints 'Total general de votos válidamente emitidos', 'Total general de votos en blanco y nulos' (one figure, recorded as 'nulos y blancos') and 'Total general de votos emitidos' (recorded as 'total').

p5-8: Every T read was confirmed by V + M = T and by the printed department/province totals; all department, province and the 1.ª Circunscripción totals close, and the Total 1.ª Circunscripción row equals the reference list votes, valid (31196), null_blank (537) and cast (31733). A few faint V/M digits differ from the T arithmetic (e.g. MNI Antofagasta M read 170, T 899 implies 179; Antofagasta valid V read 5420, sums imply 5439); only T is recorded and all T values close.

p9-12: Pages 9-10 and 11-12 are facing halves of one spread: each printed row runs across both pages (parties Acción Renovadora..Socialista Popular on the left page; Laborista..Independientes, válidos, nulos y blancos and total on the right page). Each row is recorded once, as a unit on the left page (9 or 11) with all its values; the left page's axis also carries the right-page labels with their x-ranges on the facing page (listed in facing_labels, page given in facing_page). Spans are the row's y-range at the label column on the left page; the scan is slightly skewed, so on the far right of a page the same row sits about 0.01-0.015 higher.
p9-12: Only T is transcribed; V+M=T was used to settle digits. A dash means 0 and is recorded as 0 for every list that runs in the grouping.

p9-12: Grouping 3, Socialista Popular column (page 9): the right edge of the scan cuts off most of the T digits. Each commune's T was set to válidos minus the other lists (680, 370, 9, 97, 175, 77, 16, 96, 118 for Quillota..La Cruz; department 1638); every value agrees with the visible leading digits and V+M, and the province (7334) and circunscripción (9751) totals are legible and match.

p9-12: Grouping 5, Agrario Laborista: Machalí T read as 90 and Mostazal as 25 (the bleed makes them look like 98 and 35); 90 and 25 close the row to válidos and give the printed department total 1486 (V 1073, M 413).
p9-12: Grouping 5, Caupolicán: Quinta de Tilcoco válidos read as 908 (V 531 + M 377), which closes the row and the department total 9038.
p9-12: Coihueco (Chillán department) is printed with dashes in every column, válidos and total included; it is recorded with zeros. Its votes appear under the Bustamante civil circumscription.

p9-12: 'Total 15.ª Agrupación' (Itata + San Carlos, the deputies' agrupación departamental) is recorded with level 'district', and Itata and San Carlos units carry district '15.ª Agrupación'. Chillán and Bulnes units carry district '16.ª Agrupación' by inference: its total row is not on these pages.
p9-12: Group 7 continues past page 11/12; neither Ñuble's province total nor the 7.ª circunscripción total is on these pages.

p9-12: All hierarchy sums close: every unit row closes to its printed válidos and total; the units sum to every department total on these pages; the departments sum to the O'Higgins, Colchagua and 15.ª Agrupación totals; O'Higgins + Colchagua give the 5.ª circunscripción total; and the 3.ª and 5.ª circunscripción totals equal the reference list votes, valid, null_blank and cast. The Valparaíso province total could not be checked from these pages, because the other Valparaíso departments and Aconcagua are on earlier pages.

p13-16: Pages 13-14 and 15-16 are two-page spreads: the left page (13, 15) prints the party columns Acción Renovadora de Chile to Socialista Popular, the right page (14, 16) the columns Laborista to Independientes plus the totals (valid = 'Total general de votos válidamente emitidos', 'nulos y blancos' = 'Total general de votos en blanco y nulos', total = 'Total general de votos emitidos'). Merged across the spread, every row closes: the party sum equals validos, and validos + nulos y blancos = total.

p13-16: Columns where every row is a dash and the list does not run in the grouping are omitted: Acción Renovadora, Falange Nacional, Laborista, Nacional Cristiano, Mov. Nacional de Jubilados and Independientes everywhere, Socialista de Chile and Radical Doctrinario in grouping 9. Dashes in the columns of lists that run in the grouping are recorded as 0.

p13-16: Pages 13-14 begin mid-province: Depto. Yungay is the last department of Ñuble (the other Ñuble departments are on earlier pages). 'Total 16.a Agrupación' (a deputies' agrupación departamental) is recorded as level 'subtotal' with province Ñuble. The Prov. Ñuble row covers the whole province, so it does not equal the rows on these pages.

p13-16: Prov. Arauco (p15/16) = Depto. Lebu + Depto. Arauco (p13/14) + Depto. Cañete (p15/16): checked, it closes. 'Total 7.a Circunscripción' (level grouping) = Ñuble + Concepción + Arauco, and it equals the reference file's list votes, validos 93054, nulos y blancos 532 and total 93586.

p13-16: Grouping 9 starts on p15/16 under the heading 'Novena circunscripción electoral provincial: Valdivia, Osorno, Llanquihue, Aysén, Chiloé y Magallanes'. These pages cover Valdivia and Osorno provinces only, so there is no grouping total here.

p17-20: Pages 17/18 and 19/20 are facing halves of one table: the left page (17, 19) prints the party columns Acción Renovadora de Chile ... Socialista Popular, the right page (18, 20) prints Laborista ... Independientes plus 'Total general de votos válidamente emitidos' (validos), 'Total general de votos en blanco y nulos' (nulos y blancos) and 'Total general de votos emitidos' (total). Joined across the two pages, every row closes: sum of the 11 list columns = validos, and validos + nulos y blancos = total.

p17-20: Columns entirely dashed on these pages (Acción Renovadora de Chile, Falange Nacional, Socialista de Chile, Laborista, Nacional Cristiano, Radical Doctrinario, Movimiento Nacional de Jubilados, Independientes) are left out of grouping-9 rows (none runs in the 9.a circunscripción per the reference); they are recorded only on the TOTAL GENERAL (national) rows.

p17-20: 'Total 24.a Agrupación' (p17/p18, after Prov. Aysén) is the deputies' departmental grouping (Llanquihue + Aysén) printed as a running total; recorded with level 'subtotal'. No equivalent total is printed for Chiloé or Magallanes.

p17-20: Rows printed in capitals are communes; indented lower-case rows beneath them are civil circumscriptions and are given that commune (e.g. Hualaihué and Cochamó under Puerto Montt; Quenac, Mechuque, Chaulinec, Ayacara, Chaitén and Buta Chauques under Achao). No commune-total rows are printed, so the capitals row is itself a unit.

p17-20: Depto. Quinchao, Socialista Popular, Total (p19): the cell is blank/unprinted at the page edge; recorded 454 = varones 305 + mujeres 149, which also equals the sum of its eight units and closes Prov. Chiloé (383 + 1 190 + 454 = 2 027).
p17-20: Depto. Castro, Socialista Popular, varones prints as 818 in the scan but the units sum to 810 and T 1 190 = 810 + 380; only T is recorded, and T closes.
p17-20: Total 9.a Circunscripción validos (p20) has a damaged second digit; read 80 651, confirmed by 59 017 + 21 634, the list sum and 80 863 - 212, and equal to the reference.

p17-20: The scans are slightly rotated (rows rise toward the right): the row y-position changes by about -0.048 (p17), -0.026 (p18), -0.030 (p19), -0.044 (p20) per unit of x.
